notes: Choose any number of Outsiders; that number is X, the night the Xaan acts.

full.text: Mark the Xaan *NIGHT 1*. If X is 1, also mark the Xaan *X*: tonight and tomorrow, all Outsiders are poisoned.
full.reason: Says which night token goes on and what X does.

full.text: Change the Xaan’s night token to tonight (*NIGHT 2*, *NIGHT 3*). If tonight is night X, mark the Xaan *X*: tonight and tomorrow, all Outsiders are poisoned.
full.reason: Says which night token goes on and what X does.
